evidence.summary: Playtest captures show the menu rendering cleanly and readably; Settings click toggled the panel visible and Play click dismissed the GUI, with zero runtime errors in logs.

reasons: All 10 briefed elements present and laid out per edit-mode dump
Capture 1: rail/title/buttons render readable on player screen
Capture 3 after click:PlayButton: menu dismissed (gui.Enabled=false path)

steps: Built ScreenGui BladefallMenu in StarterGui with a 380px left rail (dark #10121A, Gotham fonts)
Laid out kicker/title/subtitle/buttons/footer with UIListLayout + UIPadding, buttons styled with UICorner + UIStroke (orange primary PLAY, slate SETTINGS)
Added hidden SettingsPanel toggled by SettingsButton; PlayButton disables the gui (MenuController LocalScript, compile-checked)
Verified visually via CoreGui preview capture (layout/readability confirmed), fixed a stripe/list-layout conflict, removed preview

recipe.text: Left-rail main menu distinct from prior center-card gui-main-menu builds: full-height dark rail on the left with a 3px orange accent stripe at its edge, vertical UIListLayout (kicker, GothamBlack 52pt title, subtitle, PLAY primary + SETTINGS secondary buttons, footer). Buttons 54px tall, UICorner 10px, UIStroke borders; Play hides the menu, Settings toggles an inline panel. Gotcha: a child stripe anchored inside a UIListLayout container gets laid out too - reparent decorative overlays to the ScreenGui root.
